title: ops.lock
description: Shellshock tool lockfile. Channels at the root, each containing tool entries keyed by tool name.

additionalProperties.description: Tools installed via this channel, a *.channel.sh plugin of the same name. Keys are tool names.

needs.description: Tools that must be installed first.

args.description: Extra arguments passed to the install command.

crate.description: Crate name when it differs from the binary name (cargo channels).

musl.description: Prefer the statically linked musl build on Linux, for crates whose default build needs a newer glibc than the host has (cargo-binstall channel).

toolchain.description: Rust toolchain to install and select (rustup channel).

pkg.description: The package when it differs from the tool name: the full Go module path (required for go-install channel), or the npm package name (npm channel).

bin.description: Script inside the package that the tool's executable runs, relative to the package root (npm channel); a shim of the tool's name goes onto PATH. A library leaves it out.
